text:
Sam: Posted launch post + replay at 08:00. Want a tight microexperiment for incoming webinar registrants: test credits vs templates vs checklist. Target: +5pp first-success in 10 days.

Rina: Proposal: 3 arms randomized by signup_id
- Arm A: 30 credits on signup + starter modal
- Arm B: templates-first (no credits) + inline tray
- Arm C: checklist-first + 5-min how-to clip (no credits)
Split ~33/33/34. Per-user cap 30, global cap 6k.

Kai: Measurement: primary = pct_first_success_24h, secondary = pct_second_request_48h. Events to track: signup.source, credit_grant, prompt_use, generation.success, video_play. I'll own SQL + dashboard.

Sam: Routing: tag inbound launch_post traffic `launch_path_march`. Eng add rule: utm_campaign==starter_launch -> onboarding_experiment_v1. Need idempotency on grants.

DataBot: PR created #1202 -> onboarding_experiment_v1. Staging checks passed.

Rina: Timing note: grant credits immediately for Arm A; templates arm can be a 12h drip. Keep timing variants minimal.

Kai: QA checklist: cohort tag on signup, credit idempotency, sample 50 users per arm verified, dashboard events firing. Running smoke at 11:00 PT.

Sam: Owners: Rina (experiment design + copy), Kai (measurement + QA), Eng (routing + grants). Target flip tomorrow 09:00 PT. If credit spend hits 80% cap, auto-failover to templates arm.

Rina: I'll post copy + subject line variants by EOD.

Sam: Thanks team — post blockers here. :rocket:
